# WH347form.com

Full site content in one markdown file: https://www.wh347form.com/llms-full.txt

Free WH-347 certified payroll generator and AI-powered certified payroll
automation for contractors and subcontractors on US public works projects
(Davis-Bacon Act / prevailing wage). The generator and California DIR eCPR
XML export run entirely in the browser — free, no signup, nothing uploaded.

## Tools (free, no signup)

- WH-347 form: official PDF download + overview: https://www.wh347form.com/wh-347-form
- Free WH-347 generator (fills the official Rev. Jan 2025 form, automatic
  overtime split, California DIR eCPR XML export in beta): https://www.wh347form.com/wh-347-generator
- AI upload beta (reads a payroll report PDF — QuickBooks, ADP, Gusto,
  crew timesheets — with two independent AI passes; disagreements are
  flagged for review, never guessed): https://www.wh347form.com/try

## Key facts

- Form WH-347 (Rev. January 2025) is the federal certified payroll report,
  filed weekly under the Davis-Bacon Act; the DOL estimates 55 minutes per
  submission by hand.
- California public works payroll is filed electronically with the DIR
  (eCPR), weekly, including statements of non-performance for no-work weeks.
- The WH-347 form itself is public domain and always free — blank PDF:
  https://www.wh347form.com/wh347-official.pdf
